description: Implementation of the E1AP CU-UP protocol handling, including message processing, UE context management, and procedures for setup, release, modification, and reset within a 3GPP network component.

classes.name: e1ap_rx_pdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class converting incoming E1AP PDUs from CU-CP into messages handled by the protocol.

classes.name: e1ap_message_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: Wrapper class that logs E1AP messages before forwarding them to the actual notifier.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes connection to CU-CP and sets up message logging.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_inactivity_notification
methods.description: Processes bearer context inactivity notifications and sends appropriate messages.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_request_required
methods.description: Handles requests to release bearer contexts.

methods.name: handle_dl_data_notification_required
methods.description: Handles downlink data notifications for a UE.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Main message dispatcher that processes incoming E1AP messages.

methods.name: handle_initiating_message
methods.description: Processes initiating E1AP messages based on type.

methods.name: handle_successful_outcome
methods.description: Processes successful outcome responses for transactions.

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Processes unsuccessful outcome responses for transactions.

methods.name: log_pdu
methods.description: Logs the details of an E1AP PDU.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Logs and forwards new incoming messages in the notifier wrapper.
